data.name: Water Blast
data.description: As a standard action, you can fire a bolt of water at a foe within 30 feet as a ranged touch attack. The foe is knocked prone, and at your option may be pushed 5 feet directly away from you. A reflex save (DC %1) negates this effect. You can use this ability %2 times per day. This bloodline power replaces dehydrating touch.|Sorcerer_SeabornWaterBlast_DC|Sorcerer_Aquatic_BloodlinePower1Times
